items.title: How Investors May Respond To Constellation Energy Stock After Earnings Estimate Upgrades
items.summary: Constellation Energy has completed the sale of about 4.4 GW of largely natural gas generation in the PJM region to LS Power, meeting required divestitures tied to its earlier Calpine acquisition and reshaping its generation mix. The divestiture, together with stronger operating cash flow, rising earnings estimates and long term power contracts, tightens Constellation Energy’s focus on higher quality clean and contracted output rather than broad gas exposure. items.title: 67% Upside for Constellation Energy? Morgan Stanley Thinks So, and Here’s How
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley kept its Overweight rating on Constellation Energy and raised its price target to $393 from $391, 67% above the stock’s price. Constellation is down 38% from its high last December, and Vistra has slid too, even though both raised their 2026 guidance.
